# slox

Source: https://github.com/vilsol/slox/blob/main/README.md

# slox

![GitHub tag (with filter)](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/vilsol/slox)
![GitHub go.mod Go version](https://img.shields.io/github/go-mod/go-version/vilsol/slox)

A small wrapper around the standard `log/slog` package that threads a `*slog.Logger` through `context.Context`.

- Request-scoped attributes (request ID, user ID, trace ID, …) flow through `context.Context` instead of an explicit logger argument.
- `With` / `WithGroup` accumulate attributes across calls; downstream code just calls `slox.Info(ctx, …)`.
- Per-context level overrides via `WithLevel` and dotted logger names via `Named`.
- Source attribution (`file:line`) points at user code, not at slox internals.
- Optional integrations: OpenTelemetry trace correlation, Google Cloud Logging field renames, and a `net/http` middleware for request-scoped attributes.

## Install

```bash
go get github.com/Vilsol/slox

# Optional integration subpackages
go get github.com/Vilsol/slox/gcp
go get github.com/Vilsol/slox/http
go get github.com/Vilsol/slox/otel
```

## Quick start

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"log/slog"
	"os"

	"github.com/Vilsol/slox"
)

func main() {
	ctx := slox.Into(context.Background(), slog.New(slog.NewJSONHandler(os.Stdout, nil)))
	ctx = slox.With(ctx, "service", "api")

	handle(ctx, "alice")
}

func handle(ctx context.Context, user string) {
	ctx = slox.With(ctx, "user", user)
	slox.Info(ctx, "request handled")
	// {"level":"INFO","msg":"request handled","service":"api","user":"alice"}
}
```

Runnable godoc examples live in [`example_test.go`](./example_test.go).

## Core API

All entry points fall back to [`slog.Default`](https://pkg.go.dev/log/slog#Default) when the context carries no logger, so they are safe to call against any `context.Context`.

### Context

| Function | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `Into(ctx, logger)` | Attach a logger to the context. A nil logger is a no-op. |
| `From(ctx)` | Retrieve the logger; falls back to `slog.Default()`. |
| `Has(ctx)` | Report whether a logger has been attached. |

### Attribute helpers

| Function | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `With(ctx, args…)` | Derive a context with additional attributes. |
| `WithGroup(ctx, name)` | Derive a context that nests subsequent attrs under a group. |
| `WithLevel(ctx, level)` | Override the minimum level for this context's logger. The override fully replaces the inner handler's `Enabled` check and can either raise or lower verbosity. |
| `Named(ctx, name)` / `Name(ctx)` | Attach a dotted-path logger name (`auth.session`) and read it back. |

### Emit

`Debug`, `Info`, `Warn`, `Error` accept the same `(ctx, msg, args…)` shape as `slog.Logger`; the `*Attrs` variants take pre-built `slog.Attr` values for fewer allocations on hot paths.

`Log(ctx, level, msg, args…)` and `LogAttrs(ctx, level, msg, attrs…)` cover custom levels.

`LogRecord(ctx, r)` dispatches a pre-built `slog.Record` and is the documented escape hatch for libraries that wrap `slox` and need to capture their own call-site PC.

### Predicates and helpers

`Enabled(ctx, level)` plus `IsDebug`, `IsInfo`, `IsWarn`, `IsError` short-circuit expensive log construction. `Err(err)` returns a `slog.Attr` keyed by `slox.ErrKey` (`"error"`) for the common pattern of attaching an error to a record.

## Subpackages

Each subpackage is independently importable and ships its own godoc.

### `slox/otel` — OpenTelemetry trace correlation

Wraps a `slog.Handler` so every record carries `trace_id` and `span_id` attributes pulled from the active OTel span on the record's context. Depends only on `go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace`, not the SDK; lives in its own Go module so consumers without OTel pay nothing.

```go
base := slog.NewJSONHandler(os.Stdout, nil)
ctx = slox.Into(ctx, slog.New(sloxotel.Handler(base)))
```

### `slox/gcp` — Google Cloud Logging

Two pieces that compose:

- `sloxgcp.ReplaceAttr` — a drop-in `slog.HandlerOptions.ReplaceAttr` that renames `level`/`msg`/`source` to Cloud Logging's `severity`/`message`/`logging.googleapis.com/sourceLocation`.
- `sloxgcp.Handler` — wraps an existing handler to inject `logging.googleapis.com/trace`, `/spanId`, and `/trace_sampled` from a configurable trace extractor (commonly wired up to `sloxotel`).

```go
inner := slog.NewJSONHandler(os.Stdout, &slog.HandlerOptions{
    AddSource:   true,
    ReplaceAttr: sloxgcp.ReplaceAttr,
})
logger := slog.New(sloxgcp.Handler(inner, sloxgcp.WithProjectID("my-project")))
```

### `slox/http` — net/http middleware

Enriches each request's context with attributes pulled from configured headers, optionally adding a generated request ID. Emitted log lines automatically include the request ID and any mapped headers.

```go
mw := sloxhttp.Middleware(
    sloxhttp.WithRequestID(),
    sloxhttp.WithHeader("X-Tenant-ID", "tenant"),
)
http.Handle("/", mw(yourHandler))
```

## Compatibility

- Requires Go 1.25 or later.
- Tests run with `CGO_ENABLED=0`; the assertion library used in tests pulls transitive dependencies that fail to compile in environments without a C toolchain.
- The `otel/` subpackage is a separate Go module with its own `go.mod`; the repository ships a `go.work` so that local development across both modules works without manual replace directives.
